articles.title: preshift added to PyPI
articles.summary: PreShift, a new Python library, tackles dataset shift detection and risk estimation in machine learning. It measures distributional changes between data, crucial for maintaining AI model accuracy. This tool ensures robust performance of intelligent systems, highlighting the technical effort in creating dependable AI applications adaptable to evolving data environments.

articles.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Russia’s St Petersburg kills 1, hits energy sites
articles.summary: A major Ukrainian drone attack struck St Petersburg, Russia, killing one person and injuring five, according to Governor Alexandre Beglov. Firefighters are actively battling the aftermath, suggesting substantial damage. This incident marks a significant escalation, demonstrating the conflict's reach into Russian urban centres and highlighting ongoing cross-border military engagements.

articles.title: Two Indonesian researchers receive Indroyono Soesilo Awards in India
articles.summary: Two Indonesian researchers were honored with Indroyono Soesilo Awards at the 47th Asian Conference on Remote Sensing (ACRS) in New Delhi on October 16, 2026. Their significant research, focusing on remote sensing applications—likely related to forestry or environmental monitoring—garnered international recognition. This achievement underscores advancements in scientific innovation and cross-national collaboration in the crucial field of remote sensing technology.

articles.summary: DC Comics is experiencing remarkable sales success, reaching levels not witnessed since the 1980s, effectively challenging Marvel Comics' historical dominance. articles.title: Russian oil terminal and data centre in St Petersburg ablaze as Kyiv launches massive drone attack after Trump's decision to waive sanctions and 'slow down' satellites
articles.summary: Ukraine launched a significant drone attack on St Petersburg, Russia, setting ablaze an oil terminal and a data centre. This marks a notable escalation in the ongoing conflict, targeting critical Russian infrastructure deep within its territory. The assault highlights Ukraine's continued capability to strike strategic assets, impacting Russia's energy and information networks amidst ongoing hostilities.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh to represent India at SCO Council of Heads of Government meet
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will represent India at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of Government meeting in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. This high-level gathering will focus on economic cooperation, trade, and regional security, allowing India to strengthen multilateral ties within the SCO framework and discuss critical regional challenges with member states like Russia, China, and Central Asian nations.
